description: Team DHARTIX (Dharti + X) is a 2-member team from KGCE, Karjat building a decision-support tool that helps farmers explore climate-resilient crop rotations by combining NASA Earth observations like POWER temperature, GPM rainfall and SMAP soil moisture with local soil health, crop characteristics and farmer priorities like water, time and cost, where farmers can select their field, see how monsoon onset has shifted
